notes: General is now two tabs, About and Updates. General had become the drawer anything unclassified fell into, and the name told you nothing about what was inside.
About leads with the product itself: the logo, SIGIL set in Anta, and the version large underneath, with the about text below. The logo is a placeholder mark until the real one is ready.
Updates holds Check for Updates and the changelog. The Installed Modules section is gone - it was internal build data behind an internal-only gate, so no customer at any tier could ever see it.

Sigil now checks for updates on its own every six hours, and marks the Updates tab with a dot when a newer version exists, so you find out without going looking. Note this is a new recurring outbound request - previously the app only…
The footer version now opens About, which is where the version it shows actually lives.
